properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured in part): the Shop stall was no fault at 18:48. Reasoning evaluation's cost grew far faster than the design (reasoning_report 91 ms to 13.3 s as steps went from about 34 to 56), because its memo is per call and is switched off under any cycle. loop_status crossed the gateway's 30 s. The engine runs the work holding the design's fair lock and never learns the caller left, and the gateway then claims "Nothing was changed" for a write it sent
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-25, on Anthony's word, after reflow2:fact:observed-the-shop-design-stalled-the-engine-and-a-timed-out-write-landed-2026-10-25.
② PRECEDENT: nothing on an engine stall or a timed-out write. Nearest: reflow2:fact:a-startup-refusal-and-the-clients-give-up-are-both-thirty-seconds (2026-09-09).
③-⑤ CANDIDATES, each with the measurement that could refute it:
(C1) a computation on the Shop grew past 30 s. Refuted if the Shop's heavy reads were flat before 18:48. MEASURED in flo2.io's call log, loop_status on 671a764fa790c030: 1.2 s (10-24 18:47), 3.7 s (19:13), 15.7 s (19:58), 11.4 / 16.1 / 28.4 s (10-25 13:49 / 14:47 / 15:40), refused at 30 s from 18:48, and 20.6 s after the restart. read_my_design_back went 0.16 s to 21.7 s, then refused. Timed one at a time on the live design after the restart: detect_gaps 60 ms, detect_defects 258 ms, confirmation_ledger 85 ms, open_questions 6.6 s, reasoning_report 13.3 s (91 ms at 15:28, when the design had about 34 steps; 56 now). SURVIVES: the reasoning evaluation dominates. MECHANISM read in reflow2-core/src/inference.rs at v0.91.0: Eval keeps a memo per evaluation, and `Eval::new` is created about 14 times, so nothing is shared across calls. A truth computed while a circle was cut beneath it is NOT memoized ("asked again from elsewhere, it is computed again", lines 980-982 and 2154-2173). Design reasoning has circles (a decision governs a requirement that is a premise of the step concluding it), so recomputation can grow very fast. NOT ESTABLISHED which of the two (the per-call memo, or no memo under cuts) dominates: a timed synthetic repro would tell them apart.
(C2) the work outlives its caller. MEASURED: chg:shop-sample-redo-of-model-measures-and-drawings-session-2026-10-25 exists although every attempt the caller saw was answered "refused ... Nothing was changed". The gateway (services/edge-gateway/src/reflow2-client.ts) aborts its fetch at 30,000 ms and sends no MCP cancellation, and the engine's sync computation has no point at which it could stop. SURVIVES.
(C3) one slow read stalls every call to the design. reflow2-mcp holds each design behind an async RwLock and runs the core's synchronous computation inside the async call ("each tool briefly locks the graph, runs the sync op, and releases"), on a tokio worker, not in spawn_blocking. A fair RwLock queues a waiting writer ahead of later readers. Consistent with the log: cheap reads still answered at 18:48 (search_design 0.1 s, closure_report 0.27 s) and timed out from about 19:07 (get_node, 30 s) once writes had queued. Other designs answered normally. SURVIVES, inferred from the code and the log; not reproduced.
(C4, outside reflow2) the gateway's wording. MEASURED in services/edge-gateway/src/tools.ts engineRefusal: any error that is not the engine's own refusal, the abort included, is answered "Could not reach the design engine just now. Nothing was changed." That claim is false for a write already sent. SURVIVES.
(C5) the observation is wrong, and the pinned thread was unrelated (compaction, another design). Not refuted outright, but the Shop's call timings above account for it. Whether the 35 minutes of 100% CPU was one call or a backlog of 30-second calls cannot be told apart from what was kept.
⑥ CLASS: an unbounded computation with no deadline, run where it blocks its neighbours, behind a client that guesses its outcome. Replies have size budgets; computations have no time budget. Not established: which memo limit dominates; whether reflow2 main (which has #796's premise reading, not yet on flo2.io) is faster or slower here. Also seen: reasoning_report ignored budget_chars 1000 and answered 34,450 characters. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
